name: Angrath
aliases: a man with the head of a bull
description: Angrath is a minotaur planeswalker with red-hot chains, a restless and wild-tempered pirate who raided the Sun Empire and wanted to return to his daughters.

status.text: As of the latest story that shows him, Angrath is alive and home at his foundry, reunited with his daughters.

citations.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath ambushes Huatli, kills her dinosaur with chains, and demands the location of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: I am the dread pirate Angrath,

citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli fights Angrath and wounds him, but he overpowers her and Inti with his searing chains.
timeline.quote: she sliced a clean line across his chest with her blade.

citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Angrath recognizes Huatli as another planeswalker and offers to help each other leave, but she wounds him and flees with Inti.
timeline.quote: You're one too!

citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: The soldier reveals that two pirate captains and a sun champion's vision are converging on Orazca.
timeline.quote: Forces are converging on your Golden City,

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Angrath appears and chases Huatli, entangling her with a chain.
timeline.quote: a chain whacked and wrapped around her ankle, yanking Huatli to the forest floor.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Angrath says he will not harm Huatli, and proposes they escape together by finding the city.
timeline.quote: Whatever prevents us from leaving this plane is locked in that city.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Angrath adds that they must kill everyone who tries to steal Orazca.
timeline.quote: And all we have to do is kill everyone who tries to steal Orazca from our grasp.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Angrath watch Orazca rise from the valley.
timeline.quote: They watched as the golden spires of Orazca climbed higher and higher above the canopy of the valley below.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli tells Angrath her emperor sent her to find Orazca.
timeline.quote: My emperor tasked me with this.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath calls every group on Ixalan ants on an anthill.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire are ants on an anthill, and so are the River Heralds and so is Torrezon and so is every other group of idiots on this plane.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath leads Huatli into the Blind Eternities-like space between planes by planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Her perception wavered, and she leaned forward into a separate realm.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli looks through Angrath's portal at a snowy mountain plane and is yanked back by the barrier.
timeline.quote: Huatli tore through space and color and back through the fabric of existence

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath names the plane they saw as Kaldheim and explains freedom starts with knowing you are trapped.
timeline.quote: Kaldheim,

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath says they must be near whatever keeps them locked on the plane.
timeline.quote: We must be near whatever is keeping us locked on this plane,

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath reveals he wants to see his daughters, whom he has not seen in fourteen years.
timeline.quote: I want to see my daughters

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Angrath find a bat-marked tomb near Orazca and Huatli recalls the legend of the Bat of the East.
timeline.quote: There's a legend that says the bat of the East met Aclazotz

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: A pale hand slides the tomb door aside and Saint Elenda emerges.
timeline.quote: a pale white hand reached out from the interior.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath identifies the vampire as Saint Elenda.
timeline.quote: You are Saint Elenda,

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda says she came only to retrieve what was hers and leave the rest in peace.
timeline.quote: To retrieve the one thing that is ours,

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda vows to teach the Legion of Dusk what they forgot and vanishes through a dark slice in the air.
timeline.quote: She stepped forward, past Huatli and Angrath, and vanished into a dark slice in the air.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath attacks Huatli with a chain, then runs ahead to Orazca.
timeline.quote: Angrath launched a chain at Huatli's face that she just barely dodged, its heat searing her cheek.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli resolves to beat Angrath to Orazca.
timeline.quote: was going to get there before she did.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli's summoned dinosaur bowls Angrath over and pins him.
timeline.quote: then effortlessly bowled him over and trapped him underfoot.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli leaves Angrath under the dinosaur and goes with Tishana.
timeline.quote: Angrath, I'm sorry, but I need to go with Tishana. We had a deal first.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath breaks down the doors, having burned through the dinosaur Huatli left on him.
timeline.quote: The golden doors to the room were lying flat on the ground, and standing above them, howling in rage, was Angrath.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli, Tishana, Angrath and Vona all touch the Immortal Sun and a surge of energy passes through them.
timeline.quote: The four of them gasped as an immense current of energy passed through them.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun vanishes and Huatli, Tishana, Vona and Angrath fall into the room below.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun vanished beneath their feet

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath curses the plane and planeswalks away, free at last.
timeline.quote: SEE YOU NEVER, PATHETIC FOOLS!

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath returns to his hometown and foundry.
timeline.quote: It was a sleepy sort of place, and Angrath was happy very little had changed.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath reunites with his daughters Rumi and Jamira.
timeline.quote: Rumi. Jamira. I'm home.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Trapped by Ixalan's Binding, Angrath joins Captain Radcliff's crew, then leads a nearly bloodless mutiny and renames the ship Devil's Chains.
timeline.quote: the minotaur led a quick and almost bloodless mutiny that left Radcliff hanging by a gaff hook strapped to the bowsprit.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angrath recognizes Huatli as a planeswalker and offers help leaving the plane; she attacks him, but they later join in the race for Orazca.
timeline.quote: He recognized Huatli as a fellow planeswalker and offered her assistance in leaving the plane in exchange for help, but at first, she attacked him and fled.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angrath tries to planeswalk to Kaldheim, deduces the blocker is near, and tells Huatli true freedom starts when one realizes one is trapped.
timeline.quote: He told Huatli that true freedom started when one realized that one was trapped.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At a tomb near Orazca they find Saint Elenda; Angrath strikes Huatli and goes on alone, and she sends a Dinosaur to trample him.
timeline.quote: Huatli reacted by sending a Dinosaur to trample him in the mud.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Immortal Sun is taken, Angrath vanishes and reunites tearfully with his daughters at the family smithy.
timeline.quote: He then reunited, teary-eyed, with his daughters at their family's smithy.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon, Angrath is trapped by Bolas's Immortal Sun and fights the Eternals, pulling some to his side with controlling magic.
timeline.quote: he could temporarily pull Eternals to his side during the fight, allowing him to amass a miniature army.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angrath leads ground units against God-Eternal Rhonas while Gideon and Aurelia lead the air, and after Gideon kills Rhonas, Angrath leads a charge that forces Bolas's forces back.
timeline.quote: After Gideon killed Rhonas, Angrath was able to lead a successful charge against the remaining Eternals

citation.text: "Angrath", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angrath chooses to remain on Ravnica after Chandra disables the Immortal Sun and helps the Gatewatch against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Angrath was one of the few planeswalkers who chose to remain on Ravnica

citation.text: "Angrath", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the battle Angrath wants to destroy the Immortal Sun but is vetoed, and tells Teyo to pity the loved ones left behind.
timeline.quote: telling the boy not to pity the dead – for their suffering is over – but rather to pity the loved ones they left behind.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aranzhur is conquered and compleated by New Phyrexia's Machine Legion; Angrath and his daughters defend it, but it is left a shell of frozen iron and ash.
timeline.quote: the plane was nothing more than a great shell of frozen iron and burning ash.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angrath loses his spark in the Desparkening and travels with his daughters through Omenpaths, agreeing Jamira should attend Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: Angrath lost his spark in the Desparkening .

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angrath's restless impatience spurs him on in an endless series of raids on the Sun Empire's coastal towns.
timeline.quote: spurs him on in an endless series of raids upon the coastal towns of the Sun Empire.

citation.text: "Angrath". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elenda meets Angrath and Huatli and is appalled that the Legion of Dusk became cruel invaders.
timeline.quote: was appalled to hear that the Legion of Dusk had become cruel invaders in her absence

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Planeswalkers visit Hazoret's camp; she tells Dack Fayden to face his destiny and lends her spear against Bolas, which Karn transports to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Hazoret lent her spear as a weapon to take down Bolas

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angrath tells Huatli he seeks the Immortal Sun and in their battle her spark ignites.
timeline.quote: In their battle, her spark ignited

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Ignited yet unawakened". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Angrath leaves her, Huatli sends a dinosaur to trample him in the mud.
timeline.quote: Huatli reacted by sending a Dinosaur to trample him in the mud.

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Search for the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Everyone scrambles to touch the Immortal Sun and a current of energy rushes through them.
timeline.quote: everyone scrambled to touch the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Search for the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli mocks Angrath for getting trapped by the Immortal Sun again.
timeline.quote: Huatli encountered Angrath at the meeting and mocked him for getting trapped by the Immortal Sun again.

citation.text: "Huatli", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli, Gideon, Aurelia and Angrath lead a force against God-Eternal Rhonas.
timeline.quote: led a massive force of planeswalkers and Boros, Izzet, and Simic troops into battle against the God-Eternal Rhonas

citation.text: "Huatli", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk, Brazen Coalition, Kumena, Huatli, Angrath and Vraska race to Orazca for the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: In the race for Orazca, the planeswalker Angrath joined the fray, as well.

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Race". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A brawl erupts in the chamber and everyone scrambles to touch the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: everyone scrambled to touch the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Fight for Control". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
